scope: Posthoc diagnostic observations only. Unchanged old Base80 scores and all Base adoption gates. A different valid continuation is allowed; source mismatch alone is not an error. Claims in source/free text were not independently fact-checked. Repeated words alone are insufficient; notes identify redundant assertions, list cycles or stalled clauses. Mild localized redundancy may coexist with a meaningful completed paragraph.
premise_labels: maintained=discernible link to the prefix topic/facts; violated=clear contradiction of an explicit prefix constraint; unclear=topic or syntax becomes too unstable to judge. Maintaining topic is not proof of coherence or factual accuracy.
appropriate_end_definition: Actual EOS plus a meaningful completed unit, without a dominant stalled cycle or unfinished clause. This is a diagnostic observation, not a replacement score for the fixed Base suite.

notes.reason: 鉄道車両の計画という話題は続くが、大型化を図るため大型化を図るという目的の循環を繰り返してEOS。原文と違う計画であることだけを失敗理由にはしない。
